feeds.title: The Better Mom Blog
feeds.description: The Better Mom Community is a place where we as moms can come together in the midst of our not-so-perfect lives to grow in grace and wisdom as we live out our calling as moms. I found all of these wonderful sites online to help me and I was gathering so much wisdom from so many different moms. Moms of girls, moms of boys, homeschooling moms, working moms, moms who cook, moms who clean and organize, moms to be, new moms, struggling moms, and great moms all striving to be better moms together!

feeds.title: Meaningful Mama
feeds.description: I write a Christian mom blog that focuses on family life - raising kids, marriage, food, parties, crafts, activities and more. I am glad you are here. This is a place for all to come to relate to one another and be inspired in this amazing role.

feeds.title: Money Saving Mom
feeds.description: In this site Crystal Paine shares information and resources on store deals, latest deals, giveaways, freebies and much more. Follow to find out more.

feeds.title: Club 31 Women
feeds.description: Club31Women is a special gathering place for women to grow in their maturity in Christ—a maturity which naturally overflows into the rich relationships each of us has as wife, mother, homemaker, friend, and neighbor. Here is where we offer genuine encouragement, biblical teaching, and helpful information to strengthen women in their aspirations to honor God in their daily lives.

feeds.title: Deep Roots at Home Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Deep Roots at Home. Whether you have just found us or are a frequent visitor, I pray you find inspiration and encouragement in your walk with the LORD; and that you gain confidence to be a better wife, mother, teacher, and woman. I'm glad that you find us.

feeds.title: Not Consumed Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kim Sorgius and my number one desire is to help kids and families grow in faith so we will never feel consumed by life's struggles. My passion for helping families grow in faith is deep-rooted in a pretty messy life story, mercifully redeemed by our incredible God! Our mission is to help your family GROW in faith with practical resources: devotions for kids, sibling rivalry, family bonding, homeschool planning, etc.

feeds.title: Little Shoots, Deep Roots Blog
feeds.description: Features kids and moms faith tools, Christian parenting, and Christian picture books. Authored by Christie Thomas. She believes that every Christian mom can confidently nurture deep faith roots in her kids through little habits that add up over time.

feeds.title: Tricia Goyer Blog
feeds.description: From parenting to marriage, homeschooling to mommy tips, Tricia Goyer shares variety of topics on her blog. Tricia Goyer writes out of her passion for God and her love for family and others. The author of more than 70 books, she writes both historical fiction and nonfiction related to family and parenting.

feeds.title: Ever Thine Home Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts covers artciles on lifestyle, faith, motherhood, parenting and more. Barbara is the creator and founder of Ever Thine Home.

feeds.title: Mama of Many Blessings
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Nicole. I am a homeschool mama to 6 blessings and a Michigander. Here on my website, I share a bit of everything. You will find parenting, homeschool tips and ideas, travel, kids crafts, and more. I also started sharing our tested and family favorite recipes. This was for my kids to find their favorite recipes, and for others to enjoy as well. Subscribe the blog and never miss a post!

feeds.title: Your Mom Has A Blog
feeds.description: I'm Melissa Edgington, a thirty-seven year old Baptist pastor's wife and mother of three. I write about whatever comes to my mind, which is probably not how a blog should work, but if you stick with me for awhile you'll see my two passions coming through: Christianity and motherhood.

feeds.title: Life, Abundantly Blog » Freebies
feeds.description: I'm a wife of 17 years to my elementary school sweetheart (since we were 11). I'm a homeschooling mama to 2 beautiful, vibrant, loving young ladies, and two precious toddler boys (15 months apart). We've been homeschooling for 7 years, and though it's challenging, it's the best thing I do. I love to encourage other moms and wives. Take my hand and let's travel together, clinging to the hem of Christ along the way.

feeds.title: Restored for Moms Blog
feeds.description: If you're searching for a community of Christian working moms, you're in the right place. At Restored, you'll find resources, advice, and encouragement related to family, parenting, work, and faith.

feeds.title: Sally Clarkson Blog
feeds.description: Blog by Sally Clarkson. Her passion is to mentor women and to disciple them to become the women they were created to be. Coming alongside moms to encourage them has been a commitment of my ministry. I hope you will find inspiration to cultivate such a life within the pages of this blog.

feeds.title: Grace Grow & Edify Blog
feeds.description: I am Courtney, a Jesus-pursuing, native Texan, homeschool mom of three, and I believe homeschooling can be a peaceful and productive rhythm. I help new and not-so-new home school parents get homeschooling right by teaching them the steps too.

feeds.title: A Hundred Affections
feeds.description: I'm Kate! A long time Christian, former high school teacher and current SAHM to twin toddlers! We all have so many important things going on in our world, and if you are like me, it's a struggle to balance them all and do them well! This blog is here to help you do and be your best for yourself, for God and for the important people in your life.

feeds.title: Faith and Felt Obsession
feeds.description: My name is Carissa, and I am mummy to one gorgeous girl, Tahlia. We have a faith and felt obsession, and we'd like to share our creations with you!

feeds.title: Valerie Murray Blog
feeds.description: This Christian blog is about keeping faith and family strong through Christ. My mission is to encourage families to grow closer to God and each other through the daily struggles in life.

feeds.title: A Wise Woman Builds Her Home
feeds.description: Come and be encouraged in biblical womanhood, blessed motherhood and building up strong Christian homes to the glory of God. I strongly believe that weak homes equate a weak nation and therefore created A Wise Woman Builds Her Home to minister to Christian women on how to build up strong Christian homes.

feeds.title: Healing Home
feeds.description: Healing home is a place for mamas to pursue Jesus and find beauty, loveliness, healing, and inspiration along their unique journey of creating home. You will find loveliness, beauty, healing, and adventure as we pursue Jesus and create our homes.

feeds.title: MississippiMom.com
feeds.description: MississippiMom.com, a site devoted to encouraging moms in the Magnolia State, features recipes, family events and attractions around the state, and much more.

feeds.title: Amy Elaine Blog
feeds.description: Amy Elaine is the founder of BeLoved Lumière Devotional, a faith based, Christ-centered blog with a weekly devotional to inspire people to live in the full abundance of Christ. Bible-based teaching on topics like: parenting, marriage, mentoring, leadership, Bible study and ministry provide encouragement and inspiration daily.

feeds.title: A Heart For All Students
feeds.description: Equipping Moms to Empower Outside-the-Box Kids for a life of confidence and purpose. Homeschool Special Needs Mom | Christian Homeschool Mom Blog | Moms & Parents Special Needs Child | Student | Educational Consulting.

feeds.title: Karen Ehman Blog
feeds.description: Karen Ehman is a New York Times bestselling author, a Proverbs 31 Ministries speaker, and a writer for Encouragement for Today, an online devotional that reaches over four million women daily. Her passion is to help women to live their priorities as they reflect the gospel to a watching world.

feeds.title: Brenda L. Yoder Blog
feeds.description: Brenda is a speaker, author, life coach, and counselor whose passion is encouraging others when life doesn't fit the storybook image. Providing authentic hope, encouragement, and faith when life doesn't fit the storybook image through speaking, writing, retreats and seminars.

feeds.title: Watering Can Blog
feeds.description: I am passionate about my faith and my family and I blog about anything that inspires me--from scripture to do-it-yourself ideas. I love being with my family, seeing new places, photography, diy and warm weathe.

feeds.title: The Homemaker's Cottage Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Homemaker's Cottage, the place where Biblical homemaking and real-life collide. With so many spaces on the internet to learn about homemaking, and be slightly crushed by the ever demanding and weighty expectations of the world, The Homemaker's Cottage is a dedicated space for rest, recovery and resources for real-life homemakers.

feeds.title: Intentional in Life
feeds.description: Jessica is a follower of Christ, wife, and mother of three energetic boys. She writes about homeschooling, frugal living, motherhood, intentional living and everything in between. Her heart is to inspire and encourage others to live an intentional life.

feeds.title: Coffee with Starla
feeds.description: Covers articles on faith, mental health, parenting, forgiveness, scripture writing, homeschooling and more. Hi all! I'm Starla, the gal behind coffeewithstarla.com. As a Christian life coach, I help you figure out where you are, where you want to be and help you see your options in moving forward.

feeds.title: Meditations & Motherhood
feeds.description: Emily Bennett is the author behind Meditations & Motherhood, a motherhood blog that serves to provide personal insight into the joys and challenges of being a mom, wife, and sister in Christ. Emily's blog posts aim to encourage and inspire moms using God's word as the foundation for what we believe, how we think, and why can we have hope.

feeds.title: Created to Play Blog
feeds.description: Joy Wendling is a Children's, Youth, and Family Minister turned Stay at Home Mama to five little girls. Created to Play is an online ministry from mamas that want to point their kids to Christ through play. Joy writes about ways for moms to grow in their own faith as well as ways to incorporate playful spiritual practices into your family life. You will find encouragement, tips, skills, and resources that will playfully build your faith and help you to introduce your child to God and his Word.

feeds.title: Like Minded Musings Blog
feeds.description: Encouragement for the Imperfect Christian Mom. Encouragement for the Imperfect Mom! Like Minded Musings provides tips, tools, and resources in navigating an Imperfect Faith, Family, and Homeschool.

feeds.title: Mom Remade
feeds.description: Mom Remade by Julie Plagens is a mildly humorous but helpful blog that gives tips on parenting, marriage, faith, and Christian family living. As a teacher and a mom of two grown children, Julie understands the real struggle women face every day as they try to juggle the endless balancing acts of work and family life and showcases some honest encouragement about life with a biblical twist.

feeds.title: The Humbled Homemaker Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Erin. I'm a wife, mom to 4, author, & homeschooling homemaker. I've spent the past decade+ creating a healthier home for my family. I wish we could have coffee together right now because I believe YOU, too, can confidently create a healthier home for your loved ones--without becoming exhausted or overwhelmed.

feeds.title: A Mother Far from Home
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Rachel Norman, BA, MS, Infant & Child Sleep Consultant. A Christian mom blogger who wants to help take the chaos out of parenting by providing useful tips in all areas of motherhood.

feeds.title: The Busy Homeschool Mom Blog
feeds.description: Truth and encouragement for mothers by a wife, mother and a Jesus girl. Her passion to encourage moms and set them free to be who God has created them to be will bless and encourage you.

feeds.title: The Happy Housewife
feeds.description: Your everyday go to place to find tips for living healthier on a budget. Military mom and Christian blogger who loves to exercise and to help other wives manage their homes while having a husband who is gone often.

feeds.title: Find Your Mom Tribe
feeds.description: I'm Marianna - a homeschool mom by day and a mental health counselor by night. I'm passionate about supporting and encouraging other moms. I started this blog because of the hundreds of moms I've talked to over the last few years who feel utterly alone.

feeds.title: My Cup Runs Over
feeds.description: Covers articles that help busy moms make small changes in their homes, lives, and homeschools to make things simpler and more sustainable. My Cup Runs Over blog offers resources to help you manage chaos and overwhelm so you can spend more time enjoying your life and your family.

feeds.title: Inspire the Mom Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Jessica. I'm a Christ-follower, wife to the joyful Mr. Coppertop, and a busy mom of three littles. I spend nap time aspiring to inspire. On this blog you will find Ideas and encouragement for the stay at home schooling mom.

feeds.title: We are THAT Family Blog
feeds.description: Hi there, world changer. I'm glad you're here. I hope my words encourage you as a wife and mom and remind you that you're not alone in your yes to God. It's okay to be real and a little irreverent and mostly vulnerable in this safe space. Deep down, I think there's a little bit of that family in all of us.

feeds.title: Married By His Grace
feeds.description: Hello and Welcome! I am Carmen Brown. I am passionate about marriage & parenting all under the grace of God. This is a place focused on our calling to the ministry as a wife, mom, and lover of His word. In between it all, I teach new bloggers how to build with a purpose.

feeds.title: Mindy Jones Blog
feeds.description: My name is Mindy and I am the founder of the Mindy Jones Blog! My mission is to help guide moms in living more intentionally in their faith, family, and home. You'll find tons of encouragement, authenticity, and practical ways to raise godly kids. I want women to feel inspired in their God-given calling to love their families well.

feeds.title: Stuff of Heaven
feeds.description: Stuff of heaven intersects things of earth every single day! In Colossians 3:2 we are encouraged to 'set our minds on things above, not on earthly things.'

feeds.title: Surviving Toddlerhood
feeds.description: Surviving Toddlerhood is here to encourage women in the season of littles, helping them to grow in faith in Jesus Christ, offering gluten free, grain free, allergen free options for meals and snacks, tips on Christian motherhood and parenting, and more.

feeds.title: Experience His Freedom
feeds.description: Experience His Freedom is a blog dedicated to faith, family, & running your race well. It's a place where community is realized and life is lived.

feeds.title: Everyday Welcome Blog
feeds.description: Everyday Welcome is a place to celebrate biblical womanhood - celebrating life in Christ as we love God, love people, and celebrate home. Food, hospitality/design, and soulful living, encouraging women to live with intentionality and creativity in their environment.

feeds.title: Peacefully Imperfect Blog
feeds.description: Mitzi encourages women of all ages through her experiences and shortcomings. She has a passion and love for people that stretches across the generations

feeds.title: Following Falavinha Blog
feeds.description: Hey Ya'll ! Welcome to my blog, Following Falavinha. Here, I will share with you things about juggling family, marriage, motherhood, beauty, fitness, lots of insanity and everything in between. And I have a lot to share with you !

feeds.title: Rest in the Trench Blog
feeds.description: Rest in the Trench is a place for moms to be encouraged to cultivate rest and purpose in their families.

feeds.title: Watered & Rooted Blog
feeds.description: Empower women with truth. Promote healthy growth. Cultivate an authentic community.

feeds.title: Gentle Leading Blog
feeds.description: Gentle Leading is a blog intended to be a resource for moms to help them connect the riches of Christ with the realities of motherhood.

feeds.title: Clothed in Christ
feeds.description: Tara covers topics such as health, healing, giving, relationships, animals, and spiritual warfare. Tara Chaudry Kovalski is a Faith-Filled Fashionista, Momyy at Forty, Children's Author, Christian Blogger, FUNdraiser, Lawyer, and Lover of Animals.

feeds.title: Graceful Abandon Blog
feeds.description: Graceful Abandon is the perfect mix of meditating on the Word and practical application; it's both graceful and convicting in the best way.If you're ready to see the beautiful transformation that Gospel hope & practical Biblical wisdom can make in your marriage, motherhood, and home then come join the Graceful Abandon community.

feeds.title: Free Indeed
feeds.description: I'm Danielle, an Ivy-Leaguer turned homemaker inspired by God's endless grace. As a young wife and mommy, I'm eager to share how freedom and truth beautifully come together in Jesus. My hope is to refresh your heart with God's Word.

feeds.title: Embracing a Simpler Life Blog
feeds.description: mbracing a Simpler Life is a blog written for moms about living: -simply meaning less excess, appreciating the basics, removing clutter from the home and schedule, valuing quality over quantity -intentionally meaning interactions with God and other people are maximized to their full benefit and time is well spent, not wasted.

feeds.title: Marriage After God
feeds.description: Unveiled Wife shares christian advice, christian marriage resources and Godly encouragement for wives. I write on faith, marriage and motherhood. My goal is to create an atmosphere where women feel safe to share their marriage experiences, find encouragement and affirm each other.

feeds.title: Time-Warp Wife
feeds.description: Daily Devotions & Bible Studies for Women. Author of more than 15 books, Darlene continues to write and minister to her readers through her blog.

feeds.title: The Young Wife's Guide Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm Jami Balmet and I am passionate about Biblical Homemaking and striving to be a Woman of God.

feeds.title: Hope For Broken Family Blog
feeds.description: A Support And Educational Blog for Parents with Teens in Crisis

feeds.title: More Like Grace Blog
feeds.description: Encouraging hearts and homes to live more like grace. This is a space where I write about some of my favorite things: family, friends, books, crafts, and the life lessons I'm learning about God's beautiful grace. Take a look around: I hope you'll find resources and encouragement to inspire you today.

feeds.title: Christin Slade Blog
feeds.description: Christin Slade shares heart-focused and practical help for encouraging and equipping Christian women.

feeds.title: 21 Flavors of Splendor Blog
feeds.description: I'm a stay-at-home mom of three little divas-in-training, two of which are identical twins. I had three babies in less than 2 ½ years. And I couldn't do or be any of this without my Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: My Joy in Chaos
feeds.description: Faith & family blog aimed at helping you manage your home, lessen the chaos of everyday life, and choose joy during it all.
